# Buy, PPA or lease: which commercial solar quote is actually best?

> Free calculator for businesses, farms, nonprofits and landlords: compare buying commercial solar, a PPA and a lease on one set of after-tax cash flows. NPV, payback, break-even PPA rate and utility escalation sensitivity. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
